Target_Phenomenon: Minority tail dispersion beyond control baseline

Key_Advantage: Isolates genuine tail dispersion from average cell-death/translation

Mathematical_Basis: Euclidean distance between mean expression vectors
Key_Advantage: Robust summary of bulk effect; completely blind to internal tail spread

Mathematical_Basis: Pairwise inter- and intra-distribution Euclidean distances
Dose_Sensitivity: Monotonic shift dominated by centroid separation
Cell_Count_Sensitivity: Sensitive to cell number; requires subsampling
Key_Advantage: Rigorous statistical divergence test; dominated by mean shift

Mathematical_Basis: 1D scalar projection onto unit displacement vector
Dose_Sensitivity: Saturates early as responder fraction approaches 100%
Key_Advantage: Classifies responders vs non-responders along main translation axis

Mathematical_Basis: Mean Euclidean distance to condition centroid
Dose_Sensitivity: Moderate; confounds technical noise with tail spread
Cell_Count_Sensitivity: Sensitive to library size and dropout
Key_Advantage: Measures raw spread but lacks control-subtraction/tail specificity

Mathematical_Basis: Shannon entropy of normalized gene expression vector
DMSO_False_Positive_Rate: High baseline entropy across all conditions
Key_Advantage: Reflects cell differentiation state rather than perturbation tail

Target_Phenomenon: Single-cell deviation from vehicle baseline center
Mathematical_Basis: Mean Euclidean distance of condition cells to DMSO centroid
Key_Advantage: Integrates bulk translation and dispersion into a single distance
